notes.title: 🎮 Claw & Load Demo – New Update Is Ready!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Miners and Meowling Commanders![/b]

The [b]Claw & Load[/b] demo is getting an update! We've fixed bugs, added fresh content, and made improvements across the board — from smoother controls and better maps to a new boss, UI tweaks, and even a long-awaited tutorial and challenge mode.

[h3]✅ What's New in This Update[/h3][olist]  [*]    [b]Character Control Improvements[/b]    [list]      [*]Increased base movement speed and acceleration[/*]      [*]Added new movement-speed-related upgrade options[/*]      [*]Buffed existing movement-related upgrades[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Magnet Item Rework[/b]    [list]      [*]Removed the need for external upgrades to collect minerals[/*]      [*]Now collects both minerals and XP by default[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Machine Gun Upgrade Path[/b]    [list]      [*]Added global damage boost against enemies for all weapons[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Cat Archer Buffs[/b]    [list]      [*]Increased damage on E and Q skills[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Map & Resource Adjustments[/b]    [list]      [*]Tweaked the number and placement of explosive blocks in early and snowy areas[/*]      [*]Improved terrain between snowy area and treehole maze[/*]      [*]Increased spawn points and frequency of blue mineral vendors and iron balls[/*]      [*]Increased mineral drop rate in the cellar area[/*]      [*]Adjusted meowshroom spawn zones and quantity[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Game Pace Tweaks[/b]    [list]      [*]Delayed the "Dark Night" event in the snowy area from 25 to 30 minutes[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]New Gameplay Content[/b]    [list]      [*]Added post-clear [b]Challenge Mode[/b][/*]      [*]Introduced a new boss in the [b]Demonic Portal Zone[/b][/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Poison Pool Changes[/b]    [list]      [*]Changed to low HP drain + heavy slow[/*]      [*]Visual guidance and warnings to be improved in future[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]New Player Tutorial[/b]    [list]      [*]Added a short onboarding tutorial for new players[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]UI & Text Fixes[/b]    [list]      [*]Fixed sound effect overlay issues during firing[/*]      [*]Fixed upgrade UI error when dying during level-up[/*]      [*]Fixed Traditional Chinese text clipping[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Death Altar Guidance[/b]    [list]      [*]Added directional hints after boss death[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Orange Relic Adjustments[/b]    [list]      [*]Added multiple new orange relic effects[/*]      [*]Fixed bug where single-limit relics could appear multiple times[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    [b]Visual Effects[/b]    [list]      [*]Reduced brightness of certain skill effects[/*]    [/list]  [/*][/olist]
[b]The updated demo will be live very soon — we’d love for you to give it a try![/b]
Feel free to share your thoughts or report bugs in our Discord server.  We’re actively improving the game and working toward a stronger, fuller release!
